why: Three VIIRS thermal anomalies inside 10 km of a paddy-stubble report, and no ground station within range. The satellite is the only positive source, which is the point: corroboration must not require every source to agree, only one to say yes.
captured: FIRMS VIIRS_SNPP_NRT rows around Ludhiana, Punjab. OpenAQ has no station inside the 25 km cap there.
